nuisance_features: Nuisance design: 25-cell rover-position one-hot (24 reference-coded columns), 100-step decision-index one-hot (99 columns; reset reference), previous-action one-hot (12 columns plus reset reference), current sensor-symbol one-hot (2 columns plus NONE reference), and 7 already-sampled indicators computed from preceding executed actions and observed positions. Total 144 nuisance columns, plus 7 beliefs and an intercept. No reward, hidden quality, or future event enters the regression. No additional nuisance features; fixed layout is constant. One-hot reference coding avoids dummy/intercept redundancy. Counterfactual sensor-pair replay skipped to keep the final CPU iteration focused.
protocol: Frozen r7 update-29 sampled policies, 7 current-Good marginals, fair-prior action/observation Bayesian targets; independent own-policy fit/test streams, all valid rows including reset, no warmup exclusion. Separate affine least squares (rcond 1e-6). Compare v2 calibrated encoder = solve(EW,E) with nuisance-controlled encoder E_nc from joint activation regression on [beliefs,nuisance], calibrated as solve(E_nc W,E_nc). For each calibrated variant choose the smallest tuning λ with pooled Good→Bad pickup ≤0.10 AND Bad→Good pickup ≥0.5, else λ=1. Choose displayed variant on tuning only by (Bad→Good pickup minus Good→Bad pickup minus maximum absolute nontarget conditional-rate drift from intact across directions/qualities); ties favor v2 calibrated encoder. Freeze across agents/sites. Matched environment/action RNG across conditions; Bad→Good stops at first target pickup, Good→Bad continues every decision step. Cached K/V propagation preserved.
